unsupported: Based in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, GM Cable Contractors Inc. operates as a communications infrastructure specialist serving the Gulf South region.

Its service portfolio spans inside-plant and outside-plant construction, including LAN/WAN design and installation, fiber optic splicing and testing, directional boring for underground conduit placement, aerial cable installation, and CCTV/video surveillance systems.
The firm also supplies on-site personnel for manpower contracts, allowing clients to scale technical staffing as needed.

Known for: Consumer-driven services and support designed to deliver value; Efficient, cost-effective facilities for superior performance and reliability; Reputation for meeting or exceeding customer expectations; On-site manpower contracts for flexible technical staffing
